title: Accountability, Roles, and Responsibilities
text: Roles and responsibilities for AI system design, development, deployment, evaluation, and monitoring are clearly defined, assigned, and documented. Personnel and autonomous components have appropriate operational boundaries and authorizations.

title: System Boundaries and Autonomous Agency
text: Organizational risk tolerances and operational boundaries for autonomous agency, multi-step execution, and third-party API or tool interactions are defined, assessed, and systematically documented prior to deployment.

title: Risk Mitigation & Least Privilege Safeguards
text: Identified AI risks are mitigated through operational controls, including strict enforcement of least privilege, credential isolation, token expiration, and sandboxed tool-calling privileges for non-human identities.

title: Adversarial Robustness and Injection Prevention
text: Mechanisms and controls are implemented to protect AI systems against adversarial inputs, prompt injection, jailbreaks, data exfiltration, and unauthorized downstream tool execution triggered by untrusted context.

title: Session Attribution and Ephemeral Delegation
text: Non-human identities and autonomous service principals must not maintain broad standing access. Actions taken on behalf of end-users must enforce session-bound delegated authentication, auditable lineage, and ephemeral tokens.
